propositions: scc_loc.analyze() invokes scc via subprocess, parses JSON output, and returns AnalyzerResult with loc payload containing repo-relative POSIX file paths and per-file Code counts
scc_loc fails closed (returns Unavailable) when scc binary is missing, exits non-zero, outputs empty/unparseable JSON, without fabricating zero values
scc_loc flattens two-level scc JSON structure (data list → groups → Files array) to extract Code and Location from each entry
scc_loc does not import from rebar.grounding to maintain layer independence and avoid metrics-grounding coupling
_ACCRUING_SINCE constant is set to "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00" matching existing metrics reader modules
successful empty output (empty file set) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
